messages.subject: A favor
messages.body:
Hi,

I thought the ticket number would be enough. I gave Support 8C2F, and they still can’t find the record in the public archive.

I’ve got relay-07 written down. Could you see if the original’s there? I’d like to have something to attach when I write back.

— Mira

messages.subject: The missing notice
messages.body:
I went through the inbox again. Nothing.

I keep wondering who sent it.

— Mira
